newsitem.title: GREECE: EPIPHANIA SA MAKES TRADE DEBUT AUG 19.
newsitem.headline: EPIPHANIA SA MAKES TRADE DEBUT AUG 19.

text.p: Epiphania SA, a specialist in business publications and print communications, will make its trading debut on the bourse's small-cap parallel market on August 19, it announced on Tuesday.
Epiphania went public at 1,600 drachmas a share in early July, its IPO subscribed 23.4 times by 3,844 retail and 74 institutional investors.
It tapped the market for 588 million drachmas with an offering of 350,000 common bearer shares and a private placement of 17,500 shares.
Issue advisor and lead underwriter was Telesis Securities, joined by co-underwriters National Bank , Eurobank, Xiosbank , Alpha Brokerage, NIBID Bank and N.Devletoglou Securities.
Depository certificates will be available starting August 18 and investors may pick them up where they subscribed.

In 1996, Epiphania which designs and produces smart, upmarket business publications, had sales of 1.64 billion drachmas and pretax earnings of 289 million. It projects sales will grow to 1.8 billion this year, bringing in pretax earnings of 330 million.
Venture capital firm Baring Hellenic Ventures holds a 17.4 percent stake. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
